policy.adoption_rule: Immutable SEC source/period/subject/scope plus native Evidence, SYSTEM Review, Calculator and complete graph replay; no self-reported acceptance flag.
formal_remaining_conditions: Continuous production permission and long-term activation are outside this isolated work package
Known historical material success does not qualify every unseen filing

code_conclusions: write_result computes all canonical bytes before opening the output with xb. Existing output is never overwritten. Unsupported values fail before creating a file, eliminating the observed serialization-caused partial JSON.

The existing canonical policy maps Decimal to decimal_text strings; content_hash uses the same encoding. The test proves output parse round-trip preserves the stage/content identity. Original review bytes and their SHA are unchanged. This does not claim JSON number type preservation or atomicity against a process/filesystem failure during write.

_register_unused_budget only accepts an absent stage and a budget directory containing exactly registration.json. It checks the record self-ID, fixed kind/roots/policy/ledger origin/limits, 32-hex nonce and original creation time. It returns the original value and does not rewrite, delete or reset registration.

Stage proposal still validates independent review, clean code identity, exact data authority, scope/roots/lifetime and original seed before using registration. Slots, actions, extra files or existing stage block unused-registration reuse; original provider and SEC counters cannot be reset through this path.

Only unissued issue28v8 execution-authority binding was refreshed for the two modified implementation files. All retained older Requirement/policy versions and old execution artifacts remain unchanged. Original source bodies and ledger stay fixed.
New tests initialize the real empty ledger in both fixture data roots so the wrong-root negative reaches REGISTRATION_CHANGED. They do not mock a validator success or make HTTP requests.

evidence_reuse.reason: Runtime extraction/Reader/Evidence/Calculator, transport/control, projection and native publication/recovery implementations are unchanged by this four-file increment. Reuse is by reviewed code difference, not by relabeling old artifacts with a new head.

not_yet_proved: Two new real provider responses and fresh per-round source/result/usage review remain unexecuted.
New head remote CI was not independently inspected in this incremental record; previous reviewed remote CI refers toab49924, while same-head local38-entry fast is verified here.
Conditional repair still requires actual repair/new review/same-budget rebind and never auto-retries.
Production activation/publication and long-term scheduling remain unauthorized by this record.
